blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water has inspected and prepared its 33 reservoirs across the East Zone as part of ongoing measures to help maintain reliable water service amid the very strong El Niño, which is expected to bring prolonged dry conditions through the first half of 2027. With a combined storage capacity of 557 million liters, the reservoirs form an important part of Manila Water’s distribution network. These facilities help balance water supply and demand across different areas by storing treated water and supporting its efficient movement through the system.
